title: Ravenry protocol, version 1
description: Every JSON message of the Ravenry protocol v1. A client message validates against #/$defs/ClientMessage, a daemon message against #/$defs/DaemonMessage. See PROTOCOL.md for the semantics and the binary frames.

ClientMessage.description: Every JSON message a client sends.

DaemonMessage.description: Every JSON message the daemon sends.

RunEnv.description: approve: the variables the command runs with, shown to the person beside it. At most 16; names are letters, digits and _ (not RAVENRY_*), values one line of at most 1000 bytes.

AbsPath.description: An absolute path on the daemon's machine.

pane.description: Absent when the reporter could not say which pane it runs in.

source.description: hook: agent.report (an assistant's hook through ravenryd hook). program: an OSC 7501 status report the program printed. daemon: inferred by the daemon (the pane's process exited, or the shell drew its prompt again).

event.description: The assistant's own event name (Claude Code's and Codex's hook_event_name), status for a program's report, exit or prompt for the daemon's.

state.description: The state the report puts the agent in. Absent: it changes no state.

pid.description: The agent's process, when the reporter knows it (a hook's parent).

data.description: What the status and the hand-off read of the hook's input (PROTOCOL.md, agent.report): never the prompt, a tool's input or output.

AgentState.description: working: busy, needs nobody. needs_you: waits for a person (need says for what). idle: done with its turn, waits for the next prompt. ended: the agent's session ended or its program is gone.

since.description: When the agent entered this state.

session.description: The assistant's own session id, when reported.

AgentStatus.description: The state of the agent in a pane.

AssistantName.description: Who reports: claude, codex, any other assistant's name, the program's own name for an OSC 7501 report ("program" when it gave none).

Channel.description: A stream on this connection, given by pane.subscribe.

kind.description: A client shows a kind it does not know by its title, and offers decline.

Checkpoint.description: A point where an agent waits for a person.

command.description: The command as the person edited it, set only when it differs from the proposed one: this is what ran.

delivered.description: A secret went where it was asked to. The secret itself is never here.

reason.description: Why the person declined, when they said.

allow.description: An approved drive: for that input once, or for the agent's session.

CheckpointId.description: Opaque. ravenryd's are "c" and 7 random characters.

output.description: The end of its output as text (64 KiB), secrets masked.

code.description: The exit status, or -1 when a signal ended the process.

signal.description: The signal that ended the process.

Exit.description: How a pane's first process ended.

head.description: The commit HEAD names now. Left out in a repository with no commit.

branch.description: The branch HEAD is on. Left out when HEAD is detached.

started_on.description: The commit HEAD named when the process started: the last HEAD reflog entry at or before started_at. Left out when the reflog cannot tell.

edited.description: Tracked files modified more than a second after the process started, relative to root, newest first, at most 20.

partial.description: Not every tracked file was checked: there were more than 20000, or git did not answer in time.

GitState.description: The git work tree a process works in, read when asked.

Input.description: One piece of input. Text always names its mode; a key is a name from the spec's key list or one character, with modifiers.

delay_ms.description: Typed text only: the pause between characters (default 10).

LabelKey.description: A label's key: 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', '/' or '-'. Namespace it (ravenry.kind, myplugin/role).

Labels.description: Key-value tags for programs (the app, the hub, plugins). The daemon gives them no meaning.

Mark.description: A position in a pane's output: the number of bytes the pane had printed before it.

message.description: One line for people. Text from the program: show it as text, never as markup.

Need.description: What an agent waits for from a person.

cwd.description: The working directory: the one the pane started in, then the last one its program reported with OSC 7 for this machine.

pid.description: The first process. It leads the pane's session.

scrollback.description: History lines the pane keeps (pane.new, pane.update).

ttl_ms.description: A hidden pane closes this long after it started.

title.description: The window title the program set (OSC 0 or 2), or empty.

shell.description: Set once the program marked a prompt with OSC 133.

agent.description: Set once an agent reported on this pane.

pids.description: The processes that belong to the pane now (section 3), when pane.list asked for them with processes.

creator.description: Who started the pane: an agent drives the panes it created and asks for any other.

PaneId.description: Opaque. ravenryd makes ids unique across daemons in practice ("p" and 7 random characters).

exe_modified_at.description: When its executable file was last modified (built or installed). pane.process only.

git.description: The git work tree of its working directory, when it is in one. pane.process only.

changed.description: Whether the code it runs changed since it started, by any of changes. Left out when its start is unknown. pane.process only.

changes.description: Why changed is true: head, HEAD names another commit than it started on; files, a tracked file was modified more than a second after it started; exe, its executable file was.

Process.description: A process. Fields the system would not tell are left out.

Reply.description: What the hook answers its assistant with: these bytes on its standard output and error, and this exit status.

RequestId.description: Chosen by the client; unique among its requests that are still running.

to.description: input: typed into a running pane; run: typed into the checkpoint's command once it waits for input; env: the command's environment variable.

enter.description: input and run: end with Enter (default true).

SecretTarget.description: Where a secret goes. Never to the agent.

mark.description: The pane's output position just before the input: wait with since=mark to see what it caused.

Seq.description: An agent report's number. Each daemon numbers its reports 1, 2, 3, ... in the order it records them.

state.description: running from a command's start (OSC 133 C) to its end (D), else prompt.

command.description: The running command, or the last one, when the shell sent it.

exit_code.description: The last finished command's status, when the shell sent it.

Shell.description: What the shell's OSC 133 marks say. mark and at: when the state last changed.

width.description: In cells; a wide character covers two.

Span.description: A run of cells whose style is not the default. Absent attributes are off; absent colours are the default.

Version.description: The protocol version. Every JSON message carries it.

output.description: New output since `since`, escape sequences removed; the last 64 KiB when truncated.

changes.description: Visible rows that differ from the start of the wait.

shell.description: The shell's state when the wait ended, once the program sent OSC 133 marks.

request.description: The request of an agent.decision event.

reply.description: The decision. Leave it out to let the session go on, as far as this connection is concerned.

request.agent.decisions.description: This connection decides what hooks answer: it gets agent.decision events.

since.description: Reports after this one (default 0: the oldest kept).

request.agent.events.description: Reads the recorded agent reports, oldest first.

pane.description: The pane the agent runs in. Leave it out when unknown (a process shared by several panes).

data.description: The hook's input, at most 256 KiB as JSON. The daemon keeps only the fields PROTOCOL.md lists under agent.report (no prompt text, tool input or output).

decide.description: Ask the deciders (agent.decisions) what the hook answers, and wait for the first that decides.

timeout_ms.description: With decide: how long to wait (default 2000).

request.agent.report.description: Records what an agent did (ravenryd hook sends it for an assistant's hooks).

request.cancel.description: Stops a running pane.wait, pane.settle or pane.send, which then fails with code cancelled. A pane.close completes anyway.

command.description: With approve: the command as the person edited it. It runs instead of the proposed one.

reason.description: With decline: why, for the agent.

by.description: Where the person answered, for people: desktop, phone.

allow.description: With approve on a drive: for this input once (default), or for the agent's session.

request.checkpoint.answer.description: A person answers a checkpoint. Exactly one of choice, text, approve, secret, pick, decline.

request.checkpoint.cancel.description: The agent withdraws an open checkpoint.

all.description: Also the closed ones the daemon still holds.

pane.description: The pane the asking agent runs in.

warning.description: approve: what the agent warns the person about (what can't be undone). A client shows it as the agent's words.

reason.description: The agent's own words on why it asks.

drive.description: drive: the pane the agent asks to type into.

description.description: The agent's words on this variant.

items.description: A file, or a pane to take a shot of now.

display.description: This connection shows panes to a person, so it gets pane.focus.

activity.description: Also pane.activity, about the panes this connection does not stream.

request.events.subscribe.description: Turns on pane.* and daemon.* events for this connection.

tail.description: Read the last this many bytes.

request.file.read.description: Reads a regular file on the daemon's machine.

request.file.stat.description: Describes files on the daemon's machine.

answer_key.description: The hub's answer key: a connection over ssh that gives the key this machine trusts may act as the person (section 4, Who acts as the person).

request.hello.description: The first request on a connection.

history.description: Scrollback lines to add above the screen.

vt.description: Add the VT sequences that rebuild the screen.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

no_wait.description: For a pane this connection did not start: fail at once (forbidden, with the drive checkpoint) instead of waiting for the person.

request.pane.close.description: Ends every process of the pane and removes it.

request.pane.focus.description: Asks the connections that display panes to show this one.

labels.description: Only the panes that have every one of these labels.

processes.description: Also each running pane's pids: the processes that belong to it now.

command.description: Program and arguments, found on the pane's PATH. Absent: the login shell ($SHELL, or /bin/sh).

env.description: Added to the daemon's environment. RAVENRY_PANE and RAVENRY_SOCKET are set by the daemon and cannot be overridden. RAVENRY_SHELL_INTEGRATION=0 (or off, no, false) starts zsh, bash or fish without the daemon's shell integration (PROTOCOL.md section 3).

request.pane.process.description: What runs in the pane's foreground.

format.description: text (default): escape sequences removed; raw: base64 bytes.

request.pane.read.description: Reads past output from the pane's log.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

shell_command.description: Restart only the command the pane's shell runs, in the same pane: interrupt it as Ctrl-C does (then SIGTERM to the foreground process group at half of grace_ms, SIGKILL at its end), wait for the prompt, and type the same command line (OSC 133 C) and Enter. Fails with failed when the shell sent no command line or is at its prompt.

no_wait.description: For a pane this connection did not start: fail at once (forbidden, with the drive checkpoint) instead of waiting for the person.

request.pane.restart.description: Closes the pane as pane.close does and starts its command again, in a new pane with the same command, working directory, env, name, hidden setting, TTL and scrollback, at its current size.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

by.description: Who typed it, for a client that passes on a person's own typing (composer, phone): on a person's connection, the input is the person's.

no_wait.description: When this connection may not drive the pane yet: fail at once (forbidden, with the drive checkpoint) instead of waiting for the person.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

by.description: Who typed it, for a client that passes on a person's own typing (composer, phone): on a person's connection, the input is the person's.

no_wait.description: When this connection may not drive the pane yet: fail at once (forbidden, with the drive checkpoint) instead of waiting for the person.

request.pane.settle.description: Sends input, waits until the pane is quiet, returns what changed.

kitty_keyboard.description: This client sends keys in the Kitty keyboard protocol's encodings when the program turns them on. A program that asks (CSI ? u) hears the protocol is there only while every client streaming the pane says so.

request.pane.subscribe.description: Streams the pane's output on a new channel.

labels.description: Each label is set, or removed when null; the others stay.

scrollback.description: History lines the pane keeps from now on; a smaller limit drops the oldest.

request.pane.update.description: Changes a pane's name, labels and scrollback.

screen.description: Match text against the visible screen instead of new output.

prompt.description: Holds once the shell starts a prompt (OSC 133 A or B) after since.

request.pane.wait.description: Returns when the first condition holds.

truncated.description: The daemon no longer holds every report after since.

asked.description: How many deciders were asked (0 without decide, or with no decider connected).

reply.description: The first decider's reply that decided. Absent: answer the assistant with nothing, so it goes on.

text.description: format text: UTF-8, invalid bytes replaced.

type.description: none: nothing there, or it cannot be reached.

home.description: The home folder of the user the daemon runs as: a client says a folder on this machine with ~.

draining.description: A newer daemon version runs beside this one: new panes belong there.

person.description: Whether this connection may act as the person: answer checkpoints, decide for hooks.

history.description: How many of lines are scrollback, at the start.

displays.description: How many connections were asked (subscribed to events with display: true).

foreground.description: The leader of the terminal's foreground process group: the shell at its prompt, or the command it runs.

busy.description: The foreground is not the pane's first process: a command runs in the shell, so a window asks before closing it.

truncated.description: The log no longer holds output from since: it starts at from.

pane.description: The new pane (a new id). With shell_command, the same pane, as it is now.

replaced.description: The old pane, as it ended. With shell_command, the same pane as pane.

command.description: With shell_command: the command line typed again.

mark.description: With shell_command: the mark just before the command line was typed.

stopped_by.description: With shell_command: what ended the command.

bytes.description: Payload bytes of this channel's frames the client has processed since its last ack (a byte stream).

frame.description: On a render stream: the newest frame the client has drawn.

ack.description: Sent by a client that subscribed with ack: true (bytes), or on a render stream (frame). It has no reply.

id.description: Absent when the message could not be tied to a request.

checkpoint.description: forbidden: the drive checkpoint the refused input opened.

lease.description: leased: the lease that holds the pane.

request.description: Answer with agent.decide and this number.

timeout_ms.description: How long the hook waits; a later answer is refused.

event.agent.decision.description: A hook waits for a decision (sent to connections that called agent.decisions).

pane.description: The pane as it is after the report (its agent field), when the report names a pane that is still there.

event.checkpoint.closed.description: A checkpoint was answered, declined, cancelled or expired.

event.checkpoint.opened.description: A checkpoint opened: show it to a person.

event.checkpoint.running.description: A person let its command run; run.pane shows it.

event.daemon.draining.description: A newer daemon version runs beside this one. New panes belong there; this daemon exits once none of its panes is running.

event.pane.activity.description: A pane this connection does not stream printed: at most once a second per pane (events.subscribe with activity).

event.pane.bell.description: A pane this connection does not stream printed: at most once a second per pane (events.subscribe with activity).

event.pane.closed.description: A pane was closed and removed.

event.pane.exited.description: A pane's first process exited. The pane stays, with its screen, until it is closed (or one hour later).

event.pane.focus.description: Show this pane to the person (sent to connections that subscribed with display: true).

event.pane.prompt.description: A pane's shell state changed (its shell field: a command started or ended).

event.pane.updated.description: A pane's name or labels changed (pane.update).

event.stream.end.description: The pane's output ended (its pty closed, or the pane was closed). It follows the channel's last frame; the channel is gone.

kind.description: person: a person typed it (a display's keystrokes, or a person's client that says so with by). agent: a program inside a pane (pane is that pane). client: any other program (client is its client.name).

by.description: Who typed it, as the client said: composer, phone.

Source.description: Where input, a pane or a lease comes from.

Theme.description: A window's terminal colours: its defaults and cursor where the program set none, its 16 palette colours for the entries the program did not change.

waiting.description: Who waits for it, in turn: the first is handed the lease when it ends.

Lease.description: One driver's hold on a pane (pane.lease).

slow_bps.description: Output slowed to this many bytes a second.

term.description: The TERM the pane's next restart gets.

kind.description: send: pane.send or pane.settle. keys: a display's keystrokes, gathered. secret: a secret a person gave through a checkpoint (never its text). restart: pane.restart typed the shell's command again.

text.description: What was typed, for people: text as it was, keys as <Name>. Absent for a secret, and when masked.

lease_holder.description: The person typed while this other driver held the pane's lease: marked, never held back.

InputRecord.description: One entry of a pane's input log.

action.description: What the grant allows; one action a grant.

Grant.description: A person let an agent drive a pane it did not create, for its session.

status.description: git status's two letters, with source git.

FileTouch.description: A file the agent in a pane changed, and how that is known.

FixtureEvent.description: Output (data), or the pane's size changed (cols and rows).

Fixture.description: A recording of a pane's output with its timing: a test fixture.

reason.description: The agent's own words on why it asks, when it gave them.

action.description: What the agent asks to do to the pane: type into it (input, the default when absent), close it, restart it, or set its test conditions (override).

Drive.description: drive: who asks to type into which pane, and a preview of what.

description.description: The agent's words on this variant, shown under its picture.

Variant.description: One choice of a pick: a file on the daemon's machine (a shot of pane, when pane is set).

Region.description: A part of a variant, in fractions of its width and height.

Pick.description: A person's pick: a variant, perhaps a region of it and a note.

request.pane.inputs.description: A pane's input log: who typed what.

request.pane.grants.description: The grants that let agents drive panes they did not create.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

wait_ms.description: Wait this long, in turn, while another driver holds it.

refuse_waiting.description: With a person's release: the drivers waiting for the lease fail with leased instead of being handed it.

request.pane.lease.description: Take, renew or release a pane's lease: one driver at a time.

request.pane.files.description: The files the agent in a pane touched.

theme.description: Draw it in the window's colours, as it shows the pane live.

font_size.description: Pixels a cell's text is tall, roughly; default 14.

request.pane.shot.description: A PNG of the pane's screen.

theme.description: Draw it in the window's colours, as it shows the pane live.

font_size.description: Pixels a cell's text is tall, roughly; default 14.

request.pane.frames.description: The pane's recent screens: PNGs, or an animated GIF or APNG.

request.pane.recording.description: A span of a pane's output with its timing, as a fixture. Also for a closed pane whose log is kept.

speed.description: 1 as recorded, 2 twice as fast, 0 as fast as it goes.

font_size.description: Pixels a cell's text is tall, roughly; default 14.

request.pane.replay.description: Play a fixture into a fresh pane, or headless into a fresh screen.

history.description: How many of lines are scrollback, at the start.

reason.description: For a pane this connection did not start: the agent's own words on why, shown on the drive checkpoint it opens.

no_wait.description: When this connection may not drive the pane: fail at once (forbidden, with the drive checkpoint) instead of waiting for the person.

request.pane.override.description: Set a pane's test conditions: its size, slowed output, the TERM of its next restart.

request.pane.clear.description: Clears the pane's screen and scrollback as Cmd+K does in Terminal.app: the prompt stays at the top, everything above it goes.

cleared.description: False on the alternate screen, which belongs to a full-screen program: nothing changed.

event.pane.input.description: Someone typed into a pane: the new record of its input log.

event.pane.lease.description: A pane's lease was taken, released or ran out: its lease, or none.

y.description: Screen coordinates: row 0 is the oldest scrollback row kept.

RenderEvent.description: One input event: exactly one field.

code.description: The physical key as a W3C KeyboardEvent.code value: KeyA, Digit1, ArrowUp, Enter, F5, NumpadEnter.

mods.description: Modifier bits: 1 Shift, 2 Control, 4 Alt (Option), 8 Super (Command), 16 Caps Lock, 32 Num Lock.

consumed.description: The modifiers the keyboard layout used to produce text (Shift for A, Option for a character it types on a Mac).

text.description: What the key types with the layout and modifiers applied; empty for a control key.

unshifted.description: The character the key types with no modifier, as a code point.

option_as_alt.description: The Mac's Option key acts as Alt rather than typing characters.

mods.description: Modifier bits: 1 Shift, 2 Control, 4 Alt (Option), 8 Super (Command), 16 Caps Lock, 32 Num Lock.

x.description: From the terminal's top left corner, in the client's units.

cell_width.description: A cell's size, in the same units.

held.description: A button is down during a motion.

text.description: Text an input method committed, sent as typed.

paste.description: Pasted text: bracketed when the program asked (mode 2004), else made safe.

focus.description: The client's view gained (true) or lost focus; reported when the program asked (mode 1004).

wheel.description: A wheel or trackpad movement. The daemon sends it to the program when it asked for the mouse, as arrow keys on the alternate screen (mode 1007), and otherwise scrolls the stream's view.

rows.description: Rows up (positive) or down; a fraction of a row from a trackpad.

select.description: A step of a selection gesture; libghostty-vt decides what is selected (a click, two a word, three a line, a drag, a block).

row.description: Screen coordinates: row 0 is the oldest scrollback row kept.

extend.description: Shift: the press extends the selection.

paths.description: Files dropped on the view: pasted as their paths, quoted for a shell, separated by spaces.

cols.description: Resize the pane before the first frame (with rows).

fps.description: The client's display rate: at most this many frames a second. Default 60.

window.description: Frames sent and not yet acknowledged, at most. Default 2.

keybinds.description: The key bindings the daemon applies to this stream's keys before encoding them (docs/RENDERING.md, Key bindings): macos, or none (the default).

request.pane.render.description: Streams the pane's screen as render frames (docs/RENDERING.md) on a new channel, for a client that draws the screen itself.

offset.description: Rows up from the bottom; 0 is the live screen.

request.render.scroll.description: Shows a render stream's view scrolled into the scrollback.

request.render.input.description: A person's input on a render stream's pane: the daemon encodes it for the program's modes.

request.render.text.description: The text between two cells, inclusive, as a copy: wrapped rows joined, trailing spaces trimmed.

request.render.copy.description: The pane's selection as a copy reads it: soft-wrapped rows joined, trailing spaces trimmed.

needle.description: What to find, ASCII letters in any case; empty ends the search.

step.description: 1 the next match toward older output, -1 toward newer, 0 keeps the selected one.

request.render.find.description: Searches the pane's screen and scrollback for a render stream: its frames carry the matches on their rows, and the view scrolls to the selected one.

request.render.link.description: The link on a cell: a hyperlink (OSC 8) or a URL written in the text (http, https, file).
